excerpt: The depth overhead of the entanglement-swapping-based strategy does not exceed n/2 des, where n denotes the number of logical qubits within the quantum circuit and des is a constant factor independent from the characteristics of the original quantum circuit given by des = cle + cbsm + ccx.
overview: The equations give an explicit linear-in-n worst-case upper bound for one strategy. They separate architecture-independent circuit size from hardware constants for link entanglement, Bell-state measurement, and remote CNOT execution after Bell-state distribution.
title: Entanglement Strategy Depth Bound
